result.brief: 提出基于SVD与杠杆分数的免训练视觉token剪枝，保留视觉表征的低秩谱结构，在极端压缩下加速VLM/VLA推理。
result.reason: Training-free SVD/leverage-score visual token pruning preserving low-rank spectral structure of visual representations; a representation-level contribution relevant to visual representation learning and unified multimodal efficiency.
